## Summary

- `mise run check` runs only the structural checks. `mise run test` runs the affected bats suites, and `--all` runs every suite.
- scripts/ci-plan.sh sorts a change into the repo and the code layer and picks the suites from scripts/<x>.sh and the .watch files. The code layer is empty until the monorepo exists, and an unknown path counts as repo layer.
- One `ci` workflow (classify, check, test on Linux and macOS, ci-gate) replaces agents-check and scripts-test. ci-full.yml reruns ci when someone adds ci:full. ci ignores label events, so no run creates a skipped ci-gate.
- One `test` pre-commit hook replaces skill-drift and scripts-test. taxonomy-check accepts ci:<x> labels.
- .github/rulesets/main.json is a snapshot of the Main ruleset with ci-gate. The refinement decisions are in [this #18 comment](https://github.com/martin-macak/aade/issues/18#issuecomment-6708666640).

## Notes

- Trace: R1, R4, R5, R9, R12, R13 and R14 have uncertain cells (true, but below 0.8). That is my own judgement, not a decisionkit decision: each sub-task maps to one clause of its issue item, and each clause has a changed file, a run or a command result.
- The live Main ruleset now equals .github/rulesets/main.json and requires ci-gate. Revert: PUT the snapshot without the ci-gate entry.
- The weekly and manual runs (R7) and the push to main (R8) can run only after the merge. I will run the workflow by hand on main and link the run here.
- The commit also adds a "Body format" rule to the issue-authoring and pr-shepherd skills. It came from a separate amend of this branch.
- [#16](https://github.com/martin-macak/aade/issues/16) keeps the speed fixes. `mise run test --all` takes about 6 min until then.
